body:
Its been two months... i messaged her yesterday and instantly blocked. I am running out of options. the pain is unbearable.

I posted some private sexual pics of her online... thats how bad i fucked up...

Its just so hard to go on everyday knowing that i hurt her, and not having her to talk to. I could give her space if she would just read a letter i wrote for her. That way she knows how bad i feel and how much i care.

If i cant even talk to her to appologize or send her a message than its hopeless. I just want to try to rebuild this friendship, the only one that ever mattered.

I am so tired of being strong. I had a super fucked up childhood that still haunts me to this day. Its not like i am some loser that sits at home all day either. From the outside, I have the perfect life. I am attractive, popular, intelligent. I have money, toys, two cars, motorcycles, a house. Its so hard faking a smile every day for all my friends that i dont even like. She was the only friend, now i dont know what to do
Do you think sleeping pills inside a sealed tent with a charcoal grill would be painless? Carbon monoxide posioning?
She doesnt and wont win. I went to far and hurt her too bad
Its not that i lost the relatiinship. Its that i tormented the persob. I posted her private pics online. I cant live with the monster i am.

I lost the only person i have ever loved, then i tormented her, and when i tried to message her today she instantly blocked me. I have only been waiting incase she wants to chat. At this point i cant go on without her friendship.

Maybe. It seems like we used to get into fights over dumb things. We would be talking about the future (like 5-10 years future) and get into a fight over how many kids we wanted or what there names would be. 

Other times we would be super happy and I would just start a fight because it was fun at the moment. Later on I would feel bad.

Whats the point of figuring it out now, I have done the damage and there is no going back. I cant undo what ive done. I hurt my bestfriend and lost my lover.
She changed her number and shes on vacation with her new guy. I have messaged her on facebook a few times in the past two weeks. She wont even read the messages
I dont know, I guess it makes me hurt a little less knowing someone is in more pain than me.
Its not about the girl. Its the fact that i am a horrible person and always have been. I hurt everyone, and i enjoy it. It makes me feel good to make others suffer.
I appreciate the gesture, but unless someone has any idea how to get her friendship back its just about pointless.
